title: Colts reportedly in contract negotiations with QB Daniel Jones, WR Alec Pierce, but are they progressing?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts reportedly in contract negotiations with QB Daniel Jones, WR Alec Pierce, but are they progressing?
sources.description: The Colts are unsurprisingly in talks with their top two free agents, but there’s still a ways to go to re-sign each long-term—albeit with still having time to spare.
